impact_narrative: 92% of token validations are failing, so every new sign-in and every checkout session that needs a fresh token is blocked.
cause_summary: Commit e1f2a3b4c5 rotated the JWT signing key to kid-2026-08 and removed the previous key from the published JWKS in the same change, so tokens signed with the new key fail validation wherever the old key set is still cached.

runbook_citation.why: This is a config rollout; reverting the commit and letting CD redeploy keeps the repository the source of truth.

next_steps: Revert e1f2a3b4c5 so the previous key id is published again, then let CD redeploy auth.
Confirm token validation success recovers, and check whether checkout still shows sign-in errors.
Re-land the rotation as two deploys: publish both keys, then switch the signing key.
